# Workflow guidance

This scope supplements the [root contract](../AGENTS.md). Follow the local [shared automation
decision](../docs/decisions/0019-shared-validation-and-dependency-automation.md), [dependency
policy](../docs/dependency-policy.md), and [release process](../docs/releasing.md). Preserve automatic
ordinary updates, the fixed qualified Podman tuple, native evidence and cleanup, and explicit
software publication approval. Shared automation is development tooling, not a product dependency.
